content:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — SLO violations detected for runtime group 'cbatch-prod'. p99 latency and memory pressure spiking since ~11:30 UTC. Pager triggered.

maria (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling logs and dashboards now. What do we know about recent config changes?

ajay: Looking at metrics — KV cache size jumped from ~4GB to ~38GB in ~10 minutes. Continuous batching backlog spiked at the same time. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/cbatch/overview

sre-jen: Found a config change in the last deploy that looks suspicious: `max_batch_tokens` set to 5120 and `max_num_seqs` to 64. That combo can create huge batches and KV thrash under diverse seq lengths.

samir: Which deploy/PR made that change?

ops-bot: Deploy d-20260315-1129 by ajay completed at 2026-03-15T11:29:12Z. Config diff: cbatch.max_batch_tokens=5120 ->  multiple nodes.

maria (oncall): Ok, priority mitigation: revert to conservative defaults to stop cache blowup and tail latency. Preparing hotfix: max_batch_tokens=1024, max_num_seqs=8, batch_window_ms=25, request_timeout_ms=3000. Applying now.

maria (oncall): Running command:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/configs/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"path":"cbatch/config","changes":{"max_batch_tokens":1024,"max_num_seqs":8,"batch_window_ms":25}}'
```

ops-bot: Config applied to 6/6 nodes. Reload job started (job-id: reload-1778001122).

ajay: Seeing eviction rate increase after change — that's expected. p99 latency trending down: 980ms -> 220ms within ~2 minutes.

customer-ops-linda: Observed customer errors: 502 responses for cust-847 and cust-239 between 11:35-11:52 UTC, roughly 1200 affected requests total. Notifying AMs.

product-alex: Need craft communication for status page + outreach. Any risk of data/state loss from KV eviction?

sre-jen: No user-visible state loss — KV cache is ephemeral for prefix/kv optimization. Evictions only cost performance temporarily.

maria (oncall): Quick verification load test underway (200rps, 512-token prompts). Logs snip: 
```
[11:40:12] cbatch: batch_size=58 tokens=2978 max_kv_mem=39.5GB
[11:44:07] cbatch: hotfix applied -> max_batch_tokens=1024 max_num_seqs=8
[11:46:30] runtime: kv_cache_mem=6.1GB p99=190ms
```

ops-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 at 11:43 due to customer-facing errors.

ajay: Proposed follow-ups: 1) CI guard preventing max_batch_tokens > 2048 without review; 2) runtime circuit-breaker to stop accepting requests that would push kv_cache > 16GB; 3) add histogram alarm for `kv_cache_growth_rate`; 4) postmortem.

samir: Also adding temporary routing rule: sequences > 16 get routed to smaller-ram model variant to limit batch explosion. Deploying now as mitigation.

customer-ops-linda: Outreach sent to affected customers (cust-847, cust-239). Initial message: apology + mitigation + offer to review logs.

product-alex: Draft for status: "Between ~11:30-11:50 UTC some requests experienced elevated latency and intermittent errors due to a misconfigured continuous batching change. Mitigation deployed at 11:44 UTC, and full recovery observed by ~11:50 UTC. No persistent data loss. Engineers are implementing safeguards."

maria (oncall): Handing off in 30m to ajay. Short-term checklist left in incident doc: monitor p99 < 300ms, kv_cache_mem < 10GB sustained for 1h, verify no new errors in customer traces. Creating postmortem stub now.

ajay: Ack. I'll take watch and follow the action items. Adding CI check as PR now.

ops-bot: Monitoring reports green. p99 latency stable at ~200ms, kv_cache_mem ~6-8GB. Closing pager and converting to incident review at 12:10 UTC.

maria (oncall): Leaving final notes: cause = misconfigured continuous batching parameters (max_batch_tokens * max_num_seqs combo). Immediate mitigations = revert to conservative config + routing guard. Action owners assigned.

sre-jen: Logging follow-ups: postmortem owner = ajay, ETA for postmortem draft = EOD. CI guard owner = samir. Runtime circuit-breaker owner = sre-jen.

ajay: Will produce the postmortem with timeline and metric graphs.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident transitioned to 'investigating' -> 'postmortem' (incident-1778001122).
